meeting.title: Weekly sync
meeting.summary: Weekly implementation sync. Warehouse connection is healthy after last week's credential rotation. The customer will finish tagging the exposure models by Thursday, and the vendor side will share a draft of the executive dashboard before the next call.
action_items: Finish tagging the exposure models by Thursday
Share a draft of the executive dashboard before the next call
key_decisions: Executive dashboard will use weekly grain, not daily
meeting.notes: Credential rotation last week caused a brief sync failure; resolved same day. No open incidents.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Morning both. Usual run-through: connection status, then the exposure work, then the exec dashboard.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Connection's been solid since the credential rotation. The overnight syncs have all gone green.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Good — that outage last Tuesday was the rotation, nothing structural. Okay, exposures. Where did the tagging land?

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: About two thirds done. The finance models are tagged, the ops ones aren't yet. I'll finish tagging the exposure models by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Thursday works. Once they're tagged the lineage view fills itself in, which the exec audience will love.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: On that — leadership asked what the exec dashboard will actually look like. Do we have anything to show them?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Not yet, but I can fix that. I'll share a draft of the executive dashboard before our next call so you have something concrete to circulate.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: That would help a lot. One design question: daily or weekly numbers? Daily felt noisy in the old tool.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: For an exec audience, weekly. Daily grain invites questions about single bad days that don't mean anything.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 2
transcript.text: Agreed, let's commit to weekly grain for that one.

transcript.speaker: Speaker 1
transcript.text: Fine by me. Anything you need from us for the draft?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: No, I have enough from discovery. Alright — tagging by Thursday, draft dashboard from me before next week. Short and sweet today.
